thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: High p99 latency and increased 5xx rate for inference-service in eu-central-1. Trigger: latency > 800ms for 5m. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/alerts/1781 :rotating_light:

maria: I'm on it — paging on-call now. Any recent rollouts?

deploy-bot: INFO: Canary traffic shift started by jonah at 1781001500. 20% traffic -> v3.2. Auto-scale OK. No failures in canary window initially.

maria: ok that's probably it. Seeing p50 fine but p95/p99 spiking. Are errors 503 or timeouts?

alex: 503s and some connection reset from clients -> stack shows backend latency hitting soft OOM in kv-cache.

samir: @maria can you confirm region? dashboard shows most impact in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt). US looks fine.

maria: confirmed. Impacted customers: a handful of EU tenants, CS already getting tickets. @cs-lead please heads-up customers with temporary degradation message.

cs-lead: on it, sending message to queued EU customers now.

jonah: fyi, v3.2 introduced a kernel change that improves perf generally but increases memory per-seq for long contexts. Canary didn't exercise long-context flows. Damn.

maria: we need to stop the rollout and either revert or reduce traffic. Can we kill the traffic shift? Is there a feature flag or traffic config?

deploy-bot: COMMANDS:
```
# Show rollout
redwood deploy status inference-service --env prod --region eu-central-1
# Abort traffic shift
redwood rollout abort inference-service --canary-id 2023-11-12-1781
# Toggle feature flag
redwood flags set inference_v3_2_enabled false --scope eu-central-1
```

maria: I'm going to abort the rollout first, then toggle the flag if needed. Alex, can you stand by to run the abort?

alex: running abort now. pasted output below.

alex: ```
$ redwood rollout abort inference-service --canary-id 2023-11-12-1781
Aborting canary: draining canary instances, shifting traffic back to v3.1
Progress: 0% -> 100%
Rollback: none (traffic-only rollback).
Done.
```

maria: traffic shifted back to v3.1. Checking error rate...

deploy-bot: METRICS: 503 rate in eu-central-1 decreased from 7.2% -> 1.1% over last 3m. p99 latency still elevated at ~650ms (was 900ms).

samir: some residual warmup of caches after shift. But we should still toggle the feature flag to fully prevent any auto-retry that might re-route to v3.2.

jonah: agree. I'll flip the flag.

jonah: ```
$ redwood flags set inference_v3_2_enabled false --scope eu-central-1 --actor jonah
Flag updated: inference_v3_2_enabled = false
Propagating to routing layer (expected < 30s)
```

maria: good. Now we need to verify: smoke tests + customer-facing checks. Alex, can you run the synthetic smoke suite against eu-central-1?

alex: running smoke. Results: 30/30 requests OK, avg latency 210ms, p99 340ms. No 5xx in 2m window.

maria: great. samir, can you do a quick heap + kv-cache check on a couple v3.1 instances to make sure memory is stable?

samir: checked heap profiles on 3 instances: memory usage stable, no unusual allocations. KV cache hit-rate normal. Suspect v3.2 kernel path had increased per-request memory for long prompts.

maria: action items so far: 1) abort rollout (done), 2) flag disabled (done), 3) smoke tests (passing). We'll keep v3.2 blocked in eu until model/kernel changes are patched and benched.

product-ops: We should schedule an immediate postmortem for root cause and decide next steps (patch + staged canary with long-context tests). I'll create the ticket.

deploy-bot: NOTE: Canary autopilot disabled for inference-service in eu-central-1 until manual re-enable.

maria: handing off to @jonah for follow-up (patch + re-roll plan). I'm going to update incident doc and leave monitoring on for 1h, then handover to next shift. If anything regresses, re-page SRE.

jonah: I'll take it. My plan: reproduce locally with long-context load, add regression test to canary harness, and propose a kernel patch. ETA for initial repro: 4h.

cs-lead: I've posted a customer status update noting partial degradation in eu, now mitigated, and we are investigating. Link: https://status.redwood/incident/1781002397

maria: thanks all. Leaving channel in 10m; jonah, assume on-call for follow-up. :white_check_mark:

jonah: acknowledged. I'll sync with samir and alex and loop in research for kernel profiling.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: severity=P2, duration so far ~12m, impact: degraded responses for subset of EU tenants. Runbook tags: rollback, feature-flag, canary.

maria: closing immediate mitigation. Will file postmortem draft after initial notes. If anyone sees new spikes, re-open and ping SRE.

alex: quick snippet for postmortem log: ```
[1781002397] canary shift -> v3.2 20%
[1781002450] p99 latency spike -> 900ms
[1781002510] abort rollout -> traffic -> v3.1
[1781002570] flag disabled inference_v3_2_enabled=false
[1781002700] smoke tests pass, p99 340ms
```

jonah: thanks. I'll attach profiling artifacts and a proposed test matrix.

maria: handing over now. Thanks everyone. :pray:
